title: UneceTTParty
description: An individual, group, or body related to a Track and Trace (TT) process.

identifier.description: An identifier for this TT party.

managedCharacteristic.description: A technical characteristic managed by this TT party.

name.description: The name, expressed as text, for this TT party.

partyTypeCode.description: A code specifying the type of TT party.

residenceCountryId.description:
The identifier for the country of residence for this TT party, such as the country in which a person lives or in which a
corporation has its place of incorporation.

specifiedTTAnimal.description: A tracking animal specified for this TT party.

specifiedTTLocation.description: A location specified for this TT party.

tTPartyRoleCode.description: A code specifying the role of this TT party.

typeId.description: An identifier of the type for this TT party.
